Put e_i = d_i - 1 in {0..8}, sum 32: this is the number of partitions of 32 fitting in an 8x8 box, P(32,8,8) (at most 8 parts, each <= 8). Splitting on whether a part equals 8: P(32,8,8) = P(32,8,7) + P(24,7,8). Complementing in the 8x7 box, P(32,8,7) = P(56-32,8,7) = P(24,8,7); by conjugation P(24,7,8) = P(24,8,7). So P(32,8,8) = 2*P(24,8,7). Compute P(24,8,7) by the exact number of parts k (parts in 1..7): k=4: 5 (complement 8-d: partitions of 8 into exactly 4 parts <=7: 5111,4211,3311,3221,2222); k=5: 25 (partitions of 11 into <=5 parts each <=6: 37 total with <=5 parts minus 12 with a part >=7); k=6: 58 (partitions of 18 in a 6x6 box: by largest part 6/5/4/3 gives 29+20+8+1); k=7: 81 (partitions of 17 into <=6 parts each <=7: largest part 7/6/5/4/3 gives 26+25+20+9+1); k=8: 93 (partitions of 16 into <=6 parts each <=8: largest part 8/7/6/5/4/3 gives 18+21+23+19+11+1). Total P(24,8,7) = 5+25+58+81+93 = 262, so the answer is 2*262 = 524.
